title: Code for: Divergence of TOR and AMPK regulators across 210 eukaryotes predicts a dispensable TOR in Toxoplasma gondii
description: The code of the eleven methods that are new in this study and that produce the data of its main results: search settings chosen jointly against declared controls and decoys, a gene-tree clade criterion anchored on curated controls, the re-examination of absences, the TOR N-terminal HEAT calls, the sequence measurements of the present AMPK subunits and of the coccidian AMPKγ copies, the AMP-site geometry of predicted structures, penalised phylogenetic logistic regression with a multistart search, the models of the AMPKα C-terminal tail, the upstream-kinase classification, and the ancestral-state reconstructions. docs/code_map.md maps every table and figure of the article to this code and indexes the eight subsections of the Supplementary Methods, docs/software.md gives the version and settings of every program the study used, an external_runs/ folder in each stage directory holds the command line of every external program, and docs/constants/ publishes the values that decide a call.
